replay.title: Replay
replay.hint: Click a unit or its label to follow it with the camera and see its data top left (Esc stops); shift-click two to measure between them. Hover a unit for everything it carries.
replay.dropLinesTitle: A line from each track straight down to the floor, so heights read in a 3D view
replay.follow.chaseTitle: The camera turns with the unit: behind it stays behind it
replay.follow.orbitTitle: The camera keeps its own direction while it follows the unit
replay.hoverHint: Click: follow and show its data · Shift-click: measure
replay.units.title: Units
replay.units.more: {count, plural, one {# more} other {# more}}: search to narrow the list.
replay.units.rowTitle: {name} · {team}. Click to follow and show its data.
replay.units.noAi: This data does not say which units are AI, so every unit is listed as a player.
replay.units.aiByPilot: AI told from players by the pilot: a recording names no pilot for AI units, but AI aircraft with a pilot's name count as players.
replay.units.aiByUser: AI told from players by an empty user id.
replay.events.title: Events
replay.events.kindTitle: Show or hide this kind of event
replay.events.more: {count, plural, one {# more event} other {# more events}}: filter by kind or unit to see them.
replay.labels.title: Labels
replay.labels.declutterTitle: A label that would cover another moves beside its unit, and is left out where there is no room; the followed and selected unit are always labelled
replay.labels.fieldsHint: What a label shows. Hovering a unit shows every field it has; the card of the selected unit has its own choice (the gear).
replay.labels.reset: Back to name, vehicle, altitude and speed
replay.card.followTitle: Follow this unit with the camera
replay.card.notYet: Not in the match yet at this moment.
replay.card.gone: Not in the match at this moment (destroyed or left).
replay.field.name: Name
replay.short.name: Name
replay.field.heading: Heading
replay.short.heading: HDG
replay.events.defaultKindsTitle: Back to every kind but the frequent effects (explosions, flak, gun shots, reloads)
replay.overlay.title: Figure overlay
replay.overlay.single: The loaded data is one match: there is nothing to lay over each other. Load several matches, or data with rounds, and each plays from its own start.
replay.overlay.hintSessions: Each picked round or match plays from its own start (CS2: when the freeze time ends), all on one timeline.
replay.overlay.hintMatches: Each picked match plays from its own first sample, all on one timeline.
replay.overlay.only: Only the rounds and matches of
replay.overlay.nothing: Nothing picked: the loaded data is shown as it is.
replay.overlay.notIn: Not one of this player's: left out
replay.follow.cockpitTitle: Look out of the unit along its nose: its attitude, the horizon rolling with it
replay.follow.fixedTitle: A place of its own around the unit that turns and rolls with it: drag to move it (behind, a wingtip, head-on)
replay.follow.padlockTitle: From the cockpit, keep looking at the target
replay.follow.targetTitle: Behind the unit, looking past it at the target
replay.follow.satelliteTitle: Straight down on the unit, north up
replay.follow.chaseKeys: Drag to look around the unit · wheel or W/S closer and further · A/D and Q/E orbit · V next view · Esc stops
replay.follow.orbitKeys: Drag to look around the unit · wheel or W/S closer and further · A/D and Q/E orbit · V next view · Esc stops
replay.follow.cockpitKeys: Drag to look around in the cockpit · H the head-up display · V next view · Esc stops
replay.follow.fixedKeys: Drag to move the camera around the unit · wheel or W/S closer and further · V next view · Esc stops
replay.follow.padlockKeys: The view stays on the target · H the head-up display · V next view · Esc stops
replay.follow.targetKeys: Wheel or W/S closer and further · V next view · Esc stops
replay.follow.satelliteKeys: Drag sideways to turn the map · wheel or W/S higher and lower · V next view · Esc stops
replay.follow.needUnit: Follow a unit first: click it
replay.target.label: Target
replay.target.hint: Pick the second unit, or shift-click two units to measure and the other one becomes the target.
replay.target.swapTitle: Follow the target and target the unit followed
replay.hud.showTitle: Horizon, pitch ladder, flight path marker, heading, speed and height over the cockpit view (H)
replay.aids.title: Tactical display
replay.aids.vectorsTitle: A line to where each unit is in so many seconds at its speed and course
replay.aids.pathAheadTitle: Where each unit really flies in the next seconds, from the recording
replay.aids.attitudeTitle: The nose dashed and the lift short and dark, as Tacview draws a selected object's vectors
replay.aids.radarTitle: The radar's scan volume and range gate, from the recording's Radar properties
replay.aids.locksTitle: Lines to locked targets (red) and focused ones (dashed), from LockedTarget and FocusedTarget
replay.aids.engagementTitle: Domes of each unit's engagement range (EngagementRange, VerticalEngagementRange)
replay.aids.losTitle: The measured pair's line turns red and dashed where the ground is between them
replay.aids.keys: B bookmark · M map · V next view · Page Up/Down previous and next event · , and . a second back and on (Shift: ten)
replay.map.title: 2D map
replay.map.pipTitle: The map in a corner of the view
replay.map.fullTitle: The map over the whole view
replay.map.centreTitle: Keep the followed unit in the middle
replay.chart.openTitle: Compare units in one chart, or one value against another
replay.chart.kind.compareTitle: One value of several units over time, on one scale
replay.chart.kind.xyTitle: One value against another, each unit a line: turn rate against speed shows how it turns at each speed
replay.chart.kind.timeTitle: The followed unit's chosen values over its life, each on its own scale
replay.chart.empty: Follow or select a unit, or add one: the chart shows the followed, the selected and the target unit and those added.
replay.chart.noValue: None of these units has this value.
replay.chart.timeHint: The values are picked under the chart in the Replay section.
replay.bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
replay.bookmarks.addTitle: This moment and the camera as it is now (B)
replay.bookmarks.none: No bookmarks yet. B adds one: the moment and the camera, kept in this browser for this recording.
replay.bookmarks.goTitle: Go to this moment with this camera
replay.bookmarks.marksHint: Marked by the recording: a click goes a few seconds before it, behind the unit.
replay.bookmarks.markTitle: Go there, a few seconds before
replay.events.pauseTitle: Stop playing at each event of the kinds shown here
replay.events.noMore: No more events of the kinds shown
replay.events.csvTitle: The events as listed, as a CSV file (the flight log)
replay.stats.title: Statistics
replay.stats.shotsTitle: Shots fired: launches of missiles, rockets and bombs, and rounds where the recording counts them
replay.stats.hitsTitle: Hits on others, as the recording writes them
replay.stats.hzTitle: Samples a second in the file
replay.stats.telemetryTitle: Every value of {name}, recorded and worked out, as a CSV file
replay.stats.telemetryNone: Select or follow a unit first
replay.stats.how: Kills, deaths, shots and hits are counted from the recording's events. Take-offs and landings come from its own events or its OnGround or AGL values; marked ~ they are estimated from speed and height.
replay.labels.rulesHint: Each kind of object has its own rule: shown or not, which values, and who gets the space first when labels would cover each other.
replay.labels.cat.selectedTitle: The followed, selected, target and measured units
replay.labels.cat.weaponTitle: Missiles, rockets, bombs and shells in flight
replay.labels.cat.aiTitle: Every unit not played by a person
replay.labels.ruleShowTitle: Off: labelled only when followed, selected, the target or measured
replay.labels.priorityTitle: Who gets the space when labels would cover each other
replay.labels.ownFieldsTitle: Off: the values chosen for every unit
replay.chart.zoomHint: Wheel on the chart zooms in time, a double click shows all of it, a click goes to that moment.
replay.card.rawTitle: Every value the recording has for this unit now, as written, also those no field reads
replay.aids.sightTitle: Where the pilot looks: a dashed line along the head's yaw and pitch (PilotHeadYaw, PilotHeadPitch or a head or view angle the recording has)
replay.aids.lockLabelsTitle: The locked target's name and range on each lock line
replay.aids.engagementsTitle: A line from each unit to every opponent within range, with the range on it (several engagements at once)
replay.chart.axisTitle: What the chart runs along: time, or the distance flown through the air or over the ground
replay.geo.title: Map and position
replay.geo.notPlaced: This recording is not placed on the earth: no grid, magnetic north or glideslopes (they need latitude and longitude, as Tacview, GPS and flight-sim tables have).
replay.geo.gridLatLonTitle: Lines of latitude and longitude on the ground, at a spacing for the height you look from
replay.geo.gridMgrsTitle: The MGRS (UTM) kilometre grid of the zone under the camera, its lines labelled as a map does
replay.geo.magneticTitle: Headings and bearings magnetic (World Magnetic Model 2025, worked out here), with a compass of true and magnetic north
replay.geo.glideslopeTitle: 3° glideslopes onto every runway end near the recording, from the surveyed thresholds (OurAirports, downloaded once and kept in this browser)
replay.geo.glideFailed: The runway list could not be loaded (offline, and not kept from before).
replay.geo.glideCount: {n, plural, =0 {No runways near the recording.} one {# runway near the recording, both ends.} other {# runways near the recording, both ends.}}
replay.labels.subtitlesTitle: The recording's messages, comments and chat at the bottom of the view as they are said
replay.limits.onTitle: A floor and a ceiling: labels turn red outside them, and every crossing is listed
replay.limits.count: {n, plural, =0 {No unit goes outside.} one {# time outside.} other {# times outside.}}
replay.media.title: Audio and video
replay.media.hint: A video or sound file of this flight (a cockpit video, the radio) played in step with the replay: it plays, pauses, seeks and changes speed with the timeline. It stays in this browser.
replay.media.offsetTitle: Where in the replay the file starts, seconds from the replay's start
replay.media.startHereTitle: The file's start at the replay's current moment
replay.media.popOutTitle: Picture in picture: the video in a window of its own
replay.time.title: Time shift and trim
replay.time.shiftHint: Move a unit's flight or a whole recording in time: two sorties flown on different days side by side, two recordings of one fight lined up.
replay.time.secondsTitle: Seconds to move it by: later positive, earlier negative
replay.time.alignTitle: Move each recording so they all start together, and play them all at once
replay.time.trimTitle: Keep only the span between the two marks (both default to the ends)
replay.time.untrimTitle: The whole recording again, with the shifts kept
replay.time.csvTitle: The recording as it is now (trimmed, shifted) as a table that loads back into 3DHeat
replay.time.acmiTitle: The recording as it is now as a Tacview ACMI file, for Tacview or 3DHeat
replay.time.keys: J plays backwards, L forwards (again: pause); ◀ on the timeline.
replay.look.title: Display style
replay.look.onTitle: Redraw the replay as a debrief telemetry screen: glowing terrain contours and grid, outlined figures, range rings, altitude ladders and live panels (key T)
replay.look.part.bloomTitle: Bright lines, trails and outlines glow
replay.look.part.edgesTitle: Glowing edges where the depth breaks: silhouettes, ridges, buildings
replay.look.part.contoursTitle: Height contours on the terrain, every fifth one brighter
replay.look.part.gridTitle: A fine grid on the ground, every tenth line brighter
replay.look.part.scanTitle: Faint scan lines, a moving scan band, colour fringes and grain
replay.look.part.ringsTitle: Four rings with bearing ticks round the followed unit, and a north line
replay.look.part.laddersTitle: A pole with height ticks under each aircraft, the nearest first
replay.look.part.panelsTitle: Telemetry, kill feed, event ticker and a scrubber with the events marked
replay.look.part.directorTitle: The camera picks its own shots from the events: orbits round kills, chases behind launches, flybys and overviews
replay.look.tm.heading: Heading
replay.look.scrubTitle: Click to go to that moment; red marks kills, amber launches
replay.lookAt.bTitle: The unit the camera looks at from the followed one
replay.lookAt.pickTitle: Keep the camera on the followed unit, turned towards a second one. Ctrl- or Alt-click a unit does the same.
replay.lookAt.rowTitle: Look at this unit from the followed one (or Ctrl- or Alt-click it)
replay.lookAt.stripTitle: Between the followed unit and the one looked at
replay.card.hidden: Hidden by the recording at this moment (not destroyed).
replay.aids.linksTitle: A weapon to its launcher (dashed) and a waypoint to the next, from Parent and Next
